challenge: Match a dweller to their room
description: Every worker is matched to a room by their best SPECIAL. Open Dwellers to see the match; move someone if you like.
More living space raises the population cap. Build another quarter and a new dweller joins the vault.
Open a dweller and equip a weapon from Storage. Weapons improve combat damage; your reward adds Endurance for exploration.
Equip your Wasteland gear or another outfit. SPECIAL bonuses improve work and survival without changing base stats.
Send an adult into the wasteland, then keep building while they travel. A new resident replaces the explorer in your workforce.
Staff the Power Generator. Production counts even at full storage; gifts and objective rewards do not. A new resident joins when you claim.
Staff the Diner. Production counts even at full storage; gifts and objective rewards do not. A new resident joins when you claim.
Staff the Water Treatment. Production counts even at full storage; gifts and objective rewards do not. A new resident joins when you claim.
More residents need food, water and living space. These caps help expand production before the vault grows further.
Build an additional Power Generator beside the existing one to merge them. More floor space provides room for another worker; upgrading alone does not count.
Assign at least three residents across your Power Generators. Extra room space only increases production when staffed.

Keep food production running while your explorer travels. Actual production counts even at full storage. Claim another resident toward the Office population goal; no expedition return or family wait is required.

Keep water production running while your explorer travels. Actual production counts even at full storage. Claim another resident toward the Office population goal; no expedition return or family wait is required.
Starter residents help your vault grow. Keep living space and production ahead of claims. These caps help fund the Office; sustained food and water production bring the final two recruits.
Claim the nine earned starter residents to reach 18 living dwellers. Housing must have space for every arrival. Family growth is optional; save 1000 caps for the Office.
Build the Office for 1000 caps at population 18 to unlock quests. Equip your guaranteed rare weapon for a first mission; check available quest requirements and choose eligible crew.

Open Quests, choose an available mission and prepare eligible crew. Your Office weapon is useful equipment: keep it for the party. Start explicitly, then claim the mission rewards after the party returns.
Work, exploration and combat earn experience. Develop one dweller to level 2; the rifle helps prepare another explorer or quest member.
Use the Overseer's Office to choose missions, prepare a party and claim the rewards after each return.
Build a training room and train one stat. Choose a stat that improves a dweller's next job or quest role.
Develop a veteran through work, quests or exploration. Review newly available missions and their equipment requirements.
Expand living space and recruit or raise dwellers. Keep production and medical capacity ahead of population growth.
